start: ^I designed the entire skill combat system around the interactions of colors and guns, explicitly encouraging players to switch weapons mid-fight.
^Want to hear how the combat synergy works?
technical_detail: ^This core concept led to the development of our color skills mechanic.

^The player has access to weapons representing the three primary colors. As they swap weapons and attack, switching between the primary colors fills up secondary skill gauges that combine those two colors.
^Once mixed, it unlocks unique, powerful secondary skill usages, creating a gameplay loop that rewards aggressive color coordination and weapon cycling.
